name: NexusDB
tagline: Commercial embedded and client/server SQL database for Delphi and C++Builder, successor to FlashFiler.
description: NexusDB is a relational database engine written in Delphi for Windows developers working in Delphi, C++Builder and .NET. It can be compiled straight into an executable as an embedded engine with no extra libraries, or run as a client/server database, and it supports a large part of SQL:2003 alongside cursor-style navigation that is method-compatible with the old BDE TTable and TQuery components. Transactions, referential integrity, encryption, in-memory tables and full-text indexing are built in, and ADO.NET, ODBC and PHP connectors serve non-Delphi clients. It grew out of TurboPower's FlashFiler and has been sold by Australia's NexusDB Pty Ltd since 2003; the 4.75 line is current, with build 4.75.20 published through Embarcadero GetIt in April 2026, and a free embedded edition is available there.

pricing.notes: Free single-user embedded edition via Embarcadero GetIt; client/server and source editions are sold as commercial developer licenses.

strengths: Compiles into a Delphi executable with no external DLLs
Same engine scales from embedded single-user to client/server
TTable/TQuery-compatible API eases porting old BDE applications
Still actively updated for current RAD Studio releases
weaknesses: Small vendor and community compared with Firebird or SQLite
Commercial licensing for anything beyond the embedded free edition
useCases: Desktop and line-of-business apps built with Delphi or C++Builder
Small client/server deployments in Windows shops
